rationale: Plausible and actionable: a rigorous, controlled experimental plan is defined but current evidence is indirect and key gaps exist (no qualified spike-in recovery in low‑biomass lavage/CSF, no donor‑matched orthogonal intact‑EV data, and no large‑animal translational support). Proceed to the proposed experiments only after assay qualification (spike‑in controls, capture compatibility), within‑donor replication (≥3 donors), and resolution of required human/animal approvals; manufacturability and NHP translational risks must be assessed before any CMC adoption.
